english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the quality of acting spontaneously or off the cuff.

examples.english: The most appealing thing about this play is the actors’ spontaneity, which gives the whole performance vitality.
examples.traditional: 呢套劇最吸引嘅地方，就係演員保留咗即興性，成場戲好有生命力。
